acceptance: AGENTS.md describes the loop under Delivery modes and keeps it opt-in; WRITE-CLOSEOUT-001 says a member ends when its change is landed on the integration branch and reported, and the leader ends at the merged final PR; the worktree section shows BASE= and says integration worktrees are leader-only; the stack rule exempts members based on their leader's integration branch.
A grep finds no 'no starting-ref option' text, no runtime-unavailable claim and no check_scope or progress verb in docs/agent.
handoffs.md says the tracker is authoritative, the ledger is a rebuildable cache, and batch notes go on an umbrella item that is never a batch member.

The docs cover: members run mapped and named tests while the leader runs the fast tier once; member local review with not-reviewed for exempt-only; cloud builders are not members; the integration branch is never a PR base; one changelog fragment per member; the hosted brief cap as a hard batch-size limit; batch-wide rollback through trunk_revert.
make agent-instructions-check and make comment-policy-check pass; merged to develop; no test pins document wording.
context: Decision gate: start only after batch-land-and-status-20261101 and pr-landing-arm-batch-evidence-20261101 are done, so the docs describe shipped commands. Owner decision 2026-11-01 (owner answer in the choice dialog, BenchBox session 01a19729, 2026-11-01): "Flip it automatically if the pilot passes". This item keeps the mode opt-in; batch-loop-default-mode-20261101 flips it. Size-limit facts: brief_max_bytes is 100000 (.github/oracle-reviewers.yml); a diff over the cap switches to file-list mode, where only hard read-only reviewers that read files run, and a file list over the cap skips reviewers (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/selection.py:157-160). Guardrails: deliver as an ordinary serial PR to develop (AGENTS.md: feature delivery cannot deliver the changes that make it possible); write only from a linked worktree made with make worktree-create and checked with make agent-write-preflight, never the primary clone; stage explicit paths, never git add -A; no explanatory comments or docstrings (COMMENT-POLICY-001, make comment-policy-check); heavy test runs only through lock-taking entry points, never BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK; never weaken hold labels, the unresolved-thread refusal, oracle-gate, duration or suite gates; add a changelog.d fragment (CHANGELOG_INTERNAL when nothing is user-visible); durable artifacts carry no session or phase labels; cited line numbers are leads, so re-read the code before editing; tests prove behaviour, never wiring or wording.
description: Describe the loop as built. AGENTS.md: the two-layer loop under Delivery modes, still opt-in; a WRITE-CLOSEOUT-001 member exception; BASE= in the worktree section; integration worktrees leader-only; members based on their leader's integration branch exempt from the stack rule. docs/agent/batch-feature-delivery.md: rewrite the protocol and remove the 'no starting-ref option' text. batch-tracker-contract.md: remove the stale runtime-unavailable claim and the check_scope/progress verbs; describe the v2 contract and the leader as sole tracker writer. handoffs.md: the tracker is authoritative, the .todo-batch ledger is a rebuildable cache, batch notes go on the batch's umbrella item. Also heavy-work.md, review-protocol.md, docs/internal/oracle-review-v2.md, cloud-builder.md, docs/internal/pr-base-branch-policy.md, changelog.d/README.md with make/help.mk, docs/internal/dev-loop-worktrees.md, and an ADR in docs/internal/adr for the two-layer decision.
